assertion_audit: arm.py:52 fails if x64 is disabled; arm.py:53 fails on a non-GPU backend; neither guards occupancy arithmetic.

arm.py:138 fails when a fresh-read solved-equation residual exceeds 1e-10 after at most 20 iterations, so a step regression that prevents convergence can redden it; the final residual is computed independently through read and step_residual at lines 130-131.

timeline.py:19 fails if the arm receipt has zero or multiple TRACE rows, line 35 fails with multiple whole-step annotations, and line 58 fails if the trace has no GPU kernels; none checks the numerical busy or idle calculation.

plot.py:17 fails unless the timeline log has exactly one TIMELINE row, lines 43-48 fail on clipped or overlapping included text, and line 66 fails if reported busy exceeds reported wall; none checks that the bars match an independent GPU trace.
No added assertion compares a returned value with the same input value supplied to the code under test.

evidence.suite_arm_basis: Neither suite arm is recorded in the source manifest; zero added failures is an unobserved count, not a paired-suite pass.

0.reason: both the paired 0.716 and the estimated 0.867 fractions are printed; device activity dominates either way

1.reason: one-off measurement script; raw trace receipts retained under the run directory

2.reason: self-contained prototype plot guard; no product code

findings.text: The above-0.8 device-bound classification uses profiled GPU time divided by a different unprofiled call's wall; the directly paired bucketed fraction is 0.716, so the threshold conclusion is an estimate rather than an observed ratio. Suggested disposition: exempted because both fractions are printed and device activity still dominates the paired call.

No regression test would fail if the interval-union or idle-gap calculation changes incorrectly; the current assertions only require an arm trace and at least one kernel. Suggested disposition: exempted for this one-off measurement script while retaining its raw trace receipts.
